record.context_brief: Characterization of immediate norm continuity by the resolvent
record.original_question: Is a C0-semigroup with generator A immediately norm continuous if and only if ||R(is, A)|| tends to 0 as |s| tends to infinity?

evidence.quote: Problem 9 (Characterization of immediate norm continuity by the resolvent). Prove or disprove that a semigroup with generator A is immediately norm continuous if and only if kR(is, A)k → 0 as |s| → ∞.
Comment (Charles Batty). This problem was answered negatively, by Ralph Chill and Yuri Tomilov in [21], and independently by Tamás Mátrai in [22].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ be a $C_0$-semigroup on a complex Banach space $X$ with infinitesimal generator $A$, and let $R(\lambda, A) = (\lambda I - A)^{-1}$ denote the resolvent of $A$ for $\lambda$ in the resolvent set $\rho(A)$. The semigroup is called immediately norm continuous if the map $t \mapsto T(t)$ from $(0,\infty)$ into the space of bounded linear operators on $X$ is continuous with respect to the operator norm. Assume that the imaginary axis is contained in $\rho(A)$.

Decide whether the following equivalence holds for every such semigroup: $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ is immediately norm continuous if and only if
$$\lim_{|s|\to\infty} \|R(is, A)\| = 0.$$
Either prove this characterization or construct a counterexample.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem was resolved negatively. Counterexamples showing that the resolvent decay condition $\|R(is,A)\|\to 0$ as $|s|\to\infty$ does not imply immediate norm continuity were constructed independently by R. Chill and Y. Tomilov, and by T. Mátrai.

status_evidence.title: Operators L^1(R_+) -> X and the norm continuity problem for semigroups (Chill–Tomilov)
status_evidence.snippet: We present a new method of constructing C0-semigroups for which properties of the resolvent of the generator are not preserved by the semigroup, giving a negative answer to the norm continuity problem for semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Chill and Tomilov disprove the resolvent characterization of immediate norm continuity.

status_evidence.title: Resolvent norm decay does not characterize norm continuity (Mátrai)
status_evidence.snippet: We construct a C0-semigroup whose generator A satisfies ||R(is,A)||->0 as |s|->infinity but which is not immediately norm continuous.
